prompt: A friend who kindly gives you a lift to weekly training has arrived late three weeks in a row, so you keep missing the warm-up and feeling rushed. What response best fixes it without sounding ungrateful?

options.text: Stop accepting lifts and walk, without ever explaining why
Complain about their timing to the rest of the team
Thank them for the lifts, explain the missed warm-ups, and suggest leaving ten minutes earlier or meeting at a clearer time
Apologise for being difficult and accept being late every week

explanation: Gratitude plus a concrete suggestion about timing addresses the real problem honestly while valuing the kindness behind the lifts.
